## About
Bears Place is a motorcycle shop on Reaney Ave E in St Paul, specializing in Harley-Davidson. Bear runs the place, and if you've got an older Harley, he's the guy riders send you to.
Bear knows his stuff and he's happy to share it. One rider said he got schooled on a lot of information about his bike, and another called Bear's knowledge vast, not just a Harley snob. There's also a huge inventory of older parts on hand.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 39 Google reviews. Stop by, ask a question, and plan on a good conversation.

## Services
- Fixing older Harleys: The shop specializes in Harley-Davidson, and older Harleys are what Bear is known for.
- Tires: Bear also does tires, so you don't have to take the bike somewhere else.
- Flat tire repair: Got a flat? Bring it by and Bear will get you rolling again.
- Older parts: A huge inventory of older parts, so it's worth asking before you go hunting online.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on older Harleys?
A: Yes. Older Harleys are what Bear is known for. One reviewer called him the guy to fix your older Harley.

Q: Do you do tires?
A: Yep. Bear does tires, including flat tire repairs.

Q: Are you open on Tuesdays?
A: No, the shop is closed on Tuesdays. Check the hours listed below before you head over.
